description: Every finding carries a human-readable remediation string so consumers (humans and the controller's steer skill) get an actionable next step, not just a verdict.

requirements.title: Per-finding remediation text
requirements.description: Each scanner runner must attach a concrete remediation string to every finding it emits (e.g. gitleaks -> 'rotate the exposed credential and purge it from history; move it to vault'; osv/govulncheck -> 'bump <module> to >= <patched version>').

validation.notes: A gitleaks finding's remediation references rotation and vault.
An osv-scanner finding's remediation names the patched version to bump to.
No emitted finding has an empty remediation field.
